description: This file defines a Retrofit interface for cart-related backend API endpoints in an online shopping platform. It specifies various suspend functions for cart operations like retrieving the current cart, adding/removing items, applying/removing coupons, and coupon validation.

classes.name: CartApi
classes.description: A Retrofit interface defining API endpoints for cart operations, including fetching, updating, and coupon management.

methods.name: getCurrentCart
methods.description: Fetches the current user's cart, optionally filtered by email.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's cart with specified details.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an existing item in the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the cart based on product ID.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the current user's cart.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon to the current cart.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes any applied coupon from the cart.

methods.name: validateCoupon
methods.description: Validates a coupon via the backend's validation endpoint.

methods.name: applyCouponRules
methods.description: Applies coupon rules via the backend's apply endpoint.

methods.name: removeCouponRules
methods.description: Removes a coupon via the backend's remove endpoint.
